title: Price and McMoneagle find aliens and humans working together inside Mount Hayes
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Price and McMoneagle find aliens and humans working together inside Mount Hayes, about before Buchanan joined the unit at Mount Hayes, Alaska, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Pat Price and Joe Mcmongle had found um aliens and and humans working side by side as sort of an intelligence gathering place.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who served in a military unit of "remote viewers", people trained to try to see distant places using only the mind, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what he heard about work done before he joined. He says two of the unit's viewers, Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle, had found aliens and humans working side by side inside Mount Hayes in Alaska, at what seemed to be an intelligence gathering post. If true, it would mean aliens and people were secretly cooperating on American soil.
